text: RECENT DOCUMENTS SHOWS FOUR DIFFERENT DOCUMENTS. The NCSK's standing returns are published monthly under one name with the period in a trailing bracket, and a whole month's batch is uploaded on one day — so two of the four slots went to the same return, for July and for August, and the older of the two is superseded by the one beside it. A short list now shows the newest edition of each series (`latestOfEachSeries`): the series is the title without its trailing bracket, and editions are ranked by the register's date and then by the period the title states, because a batch uploaded together carries one date for all of it. The full collections are untouched — an earlier period is a document in its own right there. Alongside it, one recorded correction: the register publishes "[up to 31st Sugust, 2026]", and a month that does not exist makes a return's own coverage unreadable and its edition unrankable. `tidyTitle` now corrects that one word, from an explicit list of misspellings rather than a spell-checker, with the source URL and the date noticed written beside it; the Department spells it "August" in the sibling return uploaded the same day. Nothing else in a title is rewritten.
